79188.subject: Claude for Financial Advisors is Anthropic’s first AI product built for an entire job 🤖📊; No one hacked Revolut.…
79188.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/claude-for-financial-advisors-is

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we're diving into Anthropic's Claude for Financial Advisors to understand why this is less an AI chatbot for wealth managers and more Anthropic's first complete product built around a single job title (why the architectural split with OpenAI's ChatGPT for Financial Services [ https://substack.com/redirect/38e42397-20b6-47f2-ad28-c13cf3b93cbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] means the two products aren't actually competing, how Schwab and BlackRock are distributing it to 16,000+ independent RIAs, & what 3 vertical launches in the same week tell you about where Anthropic's platform strategy is actually headed + bonus deep dives into How to Build an Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5  [ https://substack.com/redirect/4f44de6a-5b79-449f-bc9d-cd3d1298ff55?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]& Top 10 Stocks Positioned to Benefit the Most from Anthropic IPO [ https://substack.com/redirect/16b76980-2e75-4529-9f8a-2e8011716c54?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and exploring the Revolut data breach to see why no one actually hacked anything, and why that's the real problem (how attackers used a compromised Italian government mailbox to trick Revolut's compliance team into handing over passport scans, selfies & full transaction histories for 680 high-value customers, why those files are now being posted on Telegram daily with a 10,000 BTC ransom demand, & what this means for every bank that processes government data requests by email + bonus reads on Revolut, Agentic Commerce & more [ https://substack.com/redirect/7b57bb60-51a4-44e4-88ad-b5b3ebc7941b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Claude for Financial Advisors is Anthropic’s first AI product built for an entire job 🤖📊
The BIG News 🔥 AI giant Anthropic just launched Claude for Financial Advisors. It ships as a plugin for Cowork [ https://substack.com/redirect/25fc4693-bdfa-45f6-a389-55a04a6a5675?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], which is basically Anthropic’s agentic desktop. What’s interesting here is that its biggest rival OpenAI had shipped ChatGPT for Financial Services [ https://substack.com/redirect/38e42397-20b6-47f2-ad28-c13cf3b93cbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] just four days earlier 👀
So, same month, and the same industry. But the two seemingly similar products, in fact, target different buyers and take opposite approaches to data and distribution.
Let’s take a closer look at this and break down the architectural split with OpenAI and what the advisor product really tells you about where Anthropic’s platform strategy is exactly headed next...
